_about: BGM Clip data, built from the confirmed Boss BGM checklist. bosses: every boss you can guess, in checklist order (clues: Normal mode hints from Boss Wordle, its lowest difficulty); areas: where each track plays, in the order the bonus round lists them (a boss without areas can be guessed but is never the answer). tracks: len in seconds; starts = whole seconds a random-start day may begin at; loop = shorter than 30 s, so it repeats. mashups: bonus for bosses with only one BGM: guess whose mashup it is (one guess). egg: a hidden extra when the mashup (or, on a track, the whole track after the game) plays. unlock: shop items a track's day finds: bonus right / won (that day only) / winAny (Archive too). noTitle: a track whose title gives the answer away (it names the part of the fight), so it has no Bonus 2. v: bumped when a track's audio file is replaced, so browsers fetch the new one.
